knowledge.content:
## Recall Pipeline

The recall pipeline uses BM25 and vector search fused via RRF. BM25 uses the 'simple' text search configuration for multilingual support. Vector search uses pgvector cosine similarity with a 0.35 minimum score threshold.

## Memory Types

Five memory types are supported: episodic, experiential, mental_model, decision, lesson. Importance is platform-assigned per type and cannot be overridden by the agent.

cases.description: knowledge vector — semantic paraphrase for doc content

knowledge.content:
## Tenant Isolation

Tenant isolation is enforced at three layers: RLS policies on all data tables, tenant_transaction() context manager that sets app.tenant_id, and the tenant isolation lint gate in CI that rejects any SQL query on a tenant-scoped table without a WHERE tenant_id clause.

## Secret Management

All secrets are stored in OpenBao. Agents access secrets via the MCP bridge using per-tenant virtual keys. The master key is never exposed to agent containers.
